# External data backbone

**Provider:** UCI Machine Learning Repository  
**Dataset:** Smartphone-Based Recognition of Human Activities and Postural Transitions  
**Source:** https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/341/smartphone+based+recognition+of+human+activities+and+postural+transitions  
**DOI/reference:** 10.24432/C54G7M  
**License/terms:** CC BY 4.0

Advertised source scale: 10,929 sensor windows from 30 subjects with six activities plus postural transitions.

Run `./data/external/fetch_public_data.ps1` on an internet-connected Windows machine to refresh the public source. Offline acceptance uses repository reference evidence and never relabels that fixture as external observation.
